message.content: In May, Hailey Johnson offered several special events and promotions at her bakery. One notable event was a free baking class which was hosted on a weekend. This event was open to anyone interested in learning to make pastries, and Li Hua expressed her interest in attending. Additionally, during the month of May, there was a special summer promotion featuring fruity ice cream and pastries. Both Li Hua and Hailey Johnson shared their preferences for these summer desserts, with Li Hua expressing enthusiasm for mango and coconut flavors, while Hailey mentioned plans for making "fruity ice cream flavors" and possibly a "mango-coconut pastry." These promotions and events highlight the variety of offerings Hailey Johnson provides to engage her customers and cater to different tastes throughout the month of May.
